festivals.title: Maha Shivaratri
festivals.description: The great night of Shiva celebrating his cosmic dance of creation and marriage to Parvati.
festivals.rituals: Keep rigorous fast, visual vigil (Jagaran), and pour sacred milk, honey, bael leaves over the Shiva Lingam at midnight.

festivals.title: Rama Navami
festivals.description: Commemorates the birth incarnation of Lord Sri Rama in Ayodhya.
festivals.rituals: Chant Ram Nama, sing Ramacharitamanas, and decorate shrines with holy saffron flags.

festivals.title: Janmashtami
festivals.description: Celebrates the mystical birth of the dark Lord Krishna in Mathura prison at midnight.
festivals.rituals: Fasting until midnight birth, swinging infant Laddu Gopal deities, singing bhajans, and Dahi Handi celebrations.

festivals.title: Ganesh Chaturthi
festivals.description: Arrival festival of Vinayakar down from the celestial abode to bless earth with wisdom.
festivals.rituals: Enshrining clay idols of Ganesha, offering 21 modaks, chanting Ganesha Atharvashirsha, and performing Visarjan (immersion).

festivals.title: Vijayadashami / Dussehra
festivals.description: Mother Durga vanquishes buffalo demon Mahishasura, and Lord Rama slays ten-headed Ravana.
festivals.rituals: Burning of giant Ravana effigies, worshipping work tools/books, and performing Shami trees worship.

festivals.title: Ganga Dussehra
festivals.description: The holy day when the celestial Goddess Ganga descended from Heaven to purify Earth.
festivals.rituals: Take a holy bath in sacred rivers, light earthen lamps (diyas), chant Ganga Gayatri, and distribute water and charity.

festivals.title: Nirjala Ekadashi
festivals.description: The most sacred, strict, and powerful waterless fast of the year. Destroys all negative karmic debris and elevates spiritual consciousness directly to Vaikuntha.
festivals.rituals: Absolute waterless fast, continuous chanting of Vishnu Sahasranama, and distributing sweet water (Sherbet) and charity to those in need.

stotrams.title: Ganesha Root Chant
stotrams.translation: O Lord Ganesha, ruler of the universe and remover of obstacles, I bow down to you in complete surrender.
stotrams.benefits: Grants continuous success, destroys external blockages, and brings incredible intellect.

stotrams.title: Sankata Nashana Ganesha Stotram
stotrams.sanskritText: Pranamya Shirasa Devam Gauri Putram Vinayakam...
stotrams.translation: By worshipping Gauri's son Ganesha daily, one achieves a long life and the fulfillment of all righteous desires.
stotrams.benefits: Directly solves severe life crises, grants steady wealth, and brings family peace.

stotrams.title: Shiva Holy Syllable Hymn
stotrams.translation: Sincere obeisance to Lord Shiva, decorated by the cobra garland, possessing three eyes, smeared in holy white ash, representing the prime syllable 'Na'.
stotrams.benefits: Establishes supreme mental focus and harmonizes energy pathways.

stotrams.title: Madhurashtakam (Hymn of Sweetness)
stotrams.sanskritText: Adharam Madhuram Vadanam Madhuram Nayanam Madhuram...
stotrams.translation: Everything associated with Sri Krishna, the master of absolute sweetness, is exceptionally sweet - His lips, eyes, gait, and heart.
stotrams.benefits: Fills the heart with pure devotional bliss and heals psychological stress.

stotrams.title: Mother Durga's Triumph Aarti
stotrams.sanskritText: Ambe Tu Hai Jagdambe Kali, Jai Durge Khappar Wali...
stotrams.translation: Glory to the protective cosmic Mother Durga, who rides a majestic lion and conquers evil forces to bless her devotees.
stotrams.benefits: Builds absolute inner strength, courage, and protects against malice or dark energy.

stotrams.title: Sri Ram Protection Hymn
stotrams.translation: The legendary story of Rama spans billions of verses; reciting even a single letter dissolves the heaviest karmic baggage.
stotrams.benefits: Constructs an invisible protective energy dome around the practitioner.

stotrams.title: Shiva Tandava Hymn of Power
stotrams.translation: Praising Shiva's ecstatic cosmic dance, with the flowing Ganga, the rhythm of his damaru drum, and his majestic crest crescent moon.
stotrams.benefits: Enhances personal magnetism, speech fluency, and shields the mind profoundly.

stotrams.title: Hare Krishna Maha Mantra
stotrams.sanskritText: Hare Krishna Hare Krishna Krishna Krishna Hare Hare, Hare Rama Hare Rama Rama Rama Hare Hare.
stotrams.translation: Chanting the ultimate holy names of God's pleasure energy to awaken spiritual self-realization.
stotrams.benefits: Breathes transcendent joy, purifies historical karma, and solves existential dread.
